name: Tsar Wars
review:
Tsar Wars is a 6x6 cluster slot where five or more connected symbols win and are destroyed. Symbols come in 1x1, 2x2 and 3x3 sizes, and every new avalanche after a win adds x1 to the multiplier.

xBomb and Trapped Wilds help keep sequences going. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 19,775x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
